show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Separated by fate but bound by blood, elder brother Virat is forced to step into the dark, ruthless world of his twin Vihan - a workplace that once nearly killed him. Disguised, determined, and driven by unfinished vengeance, Virat infiltrates Vihan’s hellish empire to hunt down the man responsible for destroying his life. This time, revenge won’t be loud or reckless - it will be slow, calculated, and deeply personal. Watch Now!
